headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Texas Rangers edged the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling 5-4 contest, and the Boston Red Sox defeated the New York Yankees 4-1.

Top MLB news saw the Astros fall to the Tigers in an 8-0 loss, with James Outman leading the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs. The Reds took down the Pirates behind Noelvi Marte's fourth home run of the season. The Nationals fell to the Orioles in a 1-3 showdown, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. The Rangers secured a hard-fought win over the Blue Jays, with Justin Foscue leading the Rangers' offense. The Astros took down the Tigers in an 8-6 victory, while the Red Sox handed the Yankees a tough loss.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Jesús Sánchez (Toronto Blue Jays) placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain. Daniel Susac (San Francisco Giants) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a low back strain. Phil Maton (Chicago Cubs) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis. Marcelo Mayer (Boston Red Sox) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a bone stress reaction to the left ulna. Robert Suarez (Atlanta Braves) has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 23, 2026, with right forearm tightness. Wenceel Pérez (Detroit Tigers) has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a left orbital fracture. Tony Santillan (Cincinnati Reds) has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 23, 2026, with a left oblique strain. Ryne Nelson (Arizona Diamondbacks) has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a strained right elbow.

The Chicago Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis. The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash. The Nationals also traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered an 8-0 loss to the Detroit Tigers, marking a disappointing end to the matchup. James Outman led the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Keider Montero pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Tigers, allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. Marte hit his fourth home run of the season, a line drive to left center field, scoring Sal Stewart.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Rogers struck out 7 batters and allowed just 1 earned run in the contest.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a hard-fought win over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 5-4. Justin Foscue led the Rangers' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured an 8-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their recent matchup. Jeremy Peña and Yainer Diaz were among the key contributors for the Astros, while Isaac Paredes and Riley Greene had notable performances for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Red Sox in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox defeated the New York Yankees 4-1, handing them a tough loss. Impact players for the Red Sox included Max Schuemann, Masataka Yoshida, and Marcelo Mayer.

top_news.title: **Jesús Sánchez Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Jesús Sánchez has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded from the New York Mets.
